question: Which Linux companion app direction should be the canonical path for this umbrella now that Windows Hub is shipped?
rationale: Current main solves much of the Windows side, but Linux remains planned and has competing security-sensitive implementation tracks that automation should not choose between.

options.title: Keep Open And Pick Linux Track
options.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while maintainers choose, narrow, or reject the active Linux companion PRs and define the security/package bar.

options.title: Split Platform Follow-Ups
options.body: Close or narrow this umbrella only after creating separate canonical Linux, Windows Hub follow-up, and platform parity items with clear owners.

options.title: Defer Desktop Apps
options.body: Leave the current Windows Hub docs as-is and explicitly defer Linux companion work until core/security priorities free capacity.

recommendation.title: Keep Open And Pick Linux Track
recommendation.body: Use this issue as the umbrella while maintainers choose, narrow, or reject the active Linux companion PRs and define the security/package bar.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete authored the issue, gave product-direction comments in the discussion, and is blamed on the current platform status docs.
